opportunity.action_idea: A daily job compares metered and allocated volumes by meter against active Sitara deal tickets and flags flow with no deal, an expired term or a strangers gas assignment. It routes each exception to the deal owner on record with the meter, dates and volumes already filled in. The deal owner still decides whether to extend, create a deal or sign off a write-off to unaccounted-for gas.
opportunity.description: Logistics and volume management find gas flowing at a meter with no deal, an expired deal or volumes on the strangers gas contract, and chase the deal owner to create or extend a Sitara ticket or approve a write-off to unaccounted-for gas.
opportunity.formula: 260 msgs / 24.06 months observed (farmer-d) = 10.81/month; x 20 min median handling x 60% automatable = 2.2 h/month; x $85/h = $184/month
opportunity.name: Meter flow with missing or expired deal resolution
